title: DDSL: Iterative Self-Labeling for Financial Market States
abstract: arXiv:2611.22958v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial market states lack a unique ground truth and must therefore be constructed from price data. Conventional labeling methods typically define states independently of the downstream classifier, leaving unresolved whether the resulting labels can be recovered from information available at prediction time. We propose DDSL, an iterative self-labeling framework that couples a price- and grammar-guided Viterbi labeler with a Transformer classifier through model feedback. DDSL constructs a nine-state representation that jointly encodes current and future market trends while retaining structured price emissions and temporal constraints throughout refinement. Experiments on SSE50, CSI300, CSI500, and NASDAQ100 show that DDSL increases held-out joint-state macro F1 by 78%-96% over single-pass dynamic-programming labeling. translated_title: DDSL：面向金融市场状态的迭代式自标注方法
translated_abstract: 金融市场状态缺乏唯一的真值标准，因此必须从价格数据中构建。传统的标注方法通常独立于下游分类器来定义状态，这使得所得到的标签能否从预测时可用的信息中恢复出来这一问题悬而未决。我们提出了DDSL，一种迭代式自标注框架，它通过模型反馈将价格与语法引导的Viterbi标注器与Transformer分类器耦合起来。DDSL构建了一种九状态表示，同时编码当前和未来的市场趋势，并在整个优化过程中保留结构化的价格发射概率与时序约束。在上证50、沪深300、中证500和纳斯达克100上的实验表明，与单次动态规划标注相比，DDSL将留出集上的联合状态宏观F1提升了78%-96%。一个从未参与标注循环的独立GRU分类器重现了相同的趋势，而标签熵……
tldr: DDSL是一种迭代自标注框架，通过价格与语法引导的Viterbi标注器和Transformer分类器之间的模型反馈耦合，构建同时编码当前与未来市场趋势的九状态金融市场表示，在多个指数数据集上将联合状态宏观F1提升78%-96%，且独立分类器可从预测时可用信息中恢复这些标签。
en_tdlr: DDSL is an iterative self-labeling framework that couples a price- and grammar-guided Viterbi labeler with a Transformer classifier through model feedback, constructing a nine-state financial market representation jointly encoding current and future trends, improving held-out joint-state macro F1 by 78%-96% across multiple indices while ensuring labels are recoverable from information available at prediction time.
